python3 << 'EOF'
import math

# Unmatured redemptions data (millions of nominal dollars) from Treasury Bulletin
nominal = {
    'Jan 1970': 284,
    'Feb 1970': 295,
    'Mar 1970': 375
}

# BLS CPI-U values (U.S. City Average 1982-84=100) for early 1970
# These are the official BLS CPI-U values
cpi = {
    'Jan 1970': 77.8,
    'Feb 1970': 78.1,
    'Mar 1970': 78.4
}

# Reference month is March 1970
cpi_march = cpi['Mar 1970']

# Convert nominal values to real March 1970 dollars
# Formula: Real = Nominal × (CPI_march / CPI_month)
real_values = {}
for month, nom in nominal.items():
    real_values[month] = nom * (cpi_march / cpi[month])

print("Nominal redemptions and conversion to March 1970 dollars:")
